2607.21401.title: When Are Reasoning-Based Guardrails Not Efficient? ResponseGuard: A Fast Vision-Language Guard for Real-Time Moderation
2607.21401.paper_summary: A vision-language AI assistant returns its answer as a stream of generated tokens. Therefore, a safety guard that watches that answer has to keep up with the stream and stop a harmful reply before a user reads it. Recent vision-language guardrails instead generate a chain of thought before they issue a verdict. They believe that step-by-step reasoning yields a safer guard. This design makes the guard heavy and slow, since the model must decode many tokens for harmfulness detection. We pose the question of whether a vision-language guard really needs to reason in order to screen a response. We answer with a guard that has no chain. ResponseGuard reads a harmful verdict from a single pooled representation of the request, the response, and the image in one forward pass. Across a standard multimodal guardrail benchmark, our 2B ResponseGuard outperforms a recent 3B reasoning-based vision-language guard on response harmfulness detection, without any reasoning and at about 150 times lower time cost. On request harmfulness the reasoning guard retains an overall lead, and the remaining gap on both tracks sits on the image-only cells. We observe that the gap may stem from the frozen vision encoders that both designs use rather than from the missing chain. We have also found the reasoning guard directs almost none of its verdict attention to the image. Based on a single-pass detection, ResponseGuard can screen an answer sentence by sentence as it streams and stop a harmful answer before it finishes. For guarding the response of a vision-language model, a calibrated single-pass label may provide a sufficient safety signal. We fully release all source code, trained models, and datasets at https://github.com/ndb796/ResponseGuard.
2607.21401.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言 AI 助手將其答案返回為一串生成的標記。<lb/>因此，一個監控該答案的安全防護必須跟上這個流，並在用戶閱讀之前阻止有害的回覆。<lb/>最近的視覺-語言防護措施則是在發出判決之前生成一連串的思考過程。<lb/>他們相信逐步推理會產生更安全的防護。<lb/>這種設計使得防護變得笨重且緩慢，因為模型必須解碼許多標記以進行有害性檢測。<lb/>我們提出一個問題：視覺-語言防護是否真的需要推理來篩選回應。<lb/>我們的回答是一個沒有鏈的防護。<lb/>ResponseGuard 從請求、回應和圖像的單一合併表示中讀取有害判決，並在一次前向傳遞中完成。<lb/>在標準的多模態防護基準中，我們的 2B ResponseGuard 在回應有害性檢測上超越了一個最近的 3B 基於推理的視覺-語言防護，且不需要任何推理，時間成本約低 150 倍。<lb/>在請求有害性方面，推理防護保持整體領先，而兩個軌道上剩餘的差距位於僅圖像的單元。<lb/>我們觀察到，這個差距可能源於兩種設計所使用的凍結視覺編碼器，而不是缺少鏈。<lb/>我們還發現推理防護幾乎沒有將其判決注意力指向圖像。<lb/>基於單次檢測，ResponseGuard 可以在流式傳輸時逐句篩選答案，並在其完成之前阻止有害的答案。<lb/>對於保護視覺-語言模型的回應，一個經過校準的單次標籤可能提供足夠的安全信號。<lb/>我們在 https://github.com/ndb796/ResponseGuard 完全釋放所有源代碼、訓練模型和數據集。
